title: Comparative Clinical Evaluation of Subepithelial Connective Tissue Graft and Xenogeneic Collagen Matrix in Treatment of Miller’s Class I and II Gingival 15 Recession: A Randomized Split-Mouth Controlled Trial
authors: Vinitha V, Chanreiphy H, Gupta V, Sahu N, Agrawal S, Goyal H. Comparative Clinical Evaluation of Subepithelial Connective Tissue Graft and Xenogeneic Collagen Matrix in Treatment of Miller's Class I and II Gingival Recession: A Randomized Split-Mouth Controlled Trial. J Pharm Bioallied Sci. 2025 Dec;17(Suppl 4):S3016-S3018.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss collprotect (porcine dermis) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The SCTG remains the benchmark for the treatment of gingival recession; XCM seems to be a good alternative, obviating the need for harvesting of grafts and reducing the morbidity at the donor site” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
